content.title: Envy-Free Cake-Cutting for Five Agents
content.abstract: We study the envy-free cake-cutting problem, in which a divisible resource must be divided among a set of agents with heterogeneous preferences in a way that ensures that no agent envies the piece obtained by another. Remarkably, under some mild continuity assumptions on the agent valuations, it is known that an envy-free division where each agent receives a \emph{connected} piece of the cake is always guaranteed to exist.
